          <div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-type="page" data-updated-on="1719070888039" id="page-60fc2d2df629417f8e2a5626"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-1 span-1"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="6e452dd0798d3122c798" id="block-6e452dd0798d3122c798"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-10 span-10"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-ba3057c23816646ffb7d"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">the Kite House</h1><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Our Kitesurfing Guest House is located directly on the main kitesurfing beach, just next to the local fishing village of Punta Chame.<br>We are open yearly from December until April and feel the best way to experience Punta Chame and the surrounding area is by staying for a few nights. We therefore have a minimum stay of 5 Nights and offer packages best suited for your perfect kitesurf holiday.</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">All meals are included and are a great mix of locally prepared meals and meals cooked at the guesthouse. </p>
</div>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our luxury villa escape is just 150 meters from our guesthouse and 50 meters from the beach. Perfect for unwinding between kite sessions, guests have full access to all of the Panama Kite House facilities and equipment storage.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">With four guest rooms in the villa, you'll find comfort in every corner. Surrounded by lush greenery, a range of tropical plants, a huge garden and chill out areas plus a pool and hot tub its a slice of paradise. Our massage therapist can also provide massages on request at the villa. <br><br>If you need more action after the kiting the villa also has a floodlit tennis court / pickle ball court and ping pong so there's plenty to enjoy. </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Choose from Bed &amp; Breakfast, Half Board, or Full Board packages, catering to families, digital nomads, groups, couples, and solo travelers alike.</p>

      <section id="panama-kitesurf" class="Index-page"  data-collection-id="60fff41ede96ba310475f078" data-parallax-id="60fff41ede96ba310475f078" data-edit-main-image="Background">
        
        <div class="Index-page-content ">
          <div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-type="page" data-updated-on="1633685433160" id="page-60fff41ede96ba310475f078"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-1 span-1"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="88541ae5629baae6c860" id="block-88541ae5629baae6c860"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-10 span-10"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-8569ac7448b2d0164919"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Kitesurfing in Punta Chame</h1><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Punta Chame is Panamas main kitesurfing location and is receiving more international attention in the last years. During the Panama summer from December until April, the northerly trade winds blow consistently and get accelerated through local land breezes during the day. Summers are hot in Panama and water temperatures are pleasant with board shorts and bikini or a thin shorty wetsuit for mornings and evenings.</p>
</div>

  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Kitesurfing Spots &amp; Trips</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Punta Chame offers a range of kite spots from the Main beach directly in front of the Guesthouse to the legendary Sand Bars and Lagoons.   <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Turtle release</h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">From December until January / Febraury we can help with the release of turtles from a turtle sanctuary close to the guesthouse.  </p>

<script>
(function () {
var carts = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.Cart'));
carts.forEach(function(cart) {
hideCart(cart);
});

/*Hide Cart*/
function hideCart(cart) {
var cartQty = cart.querySelector('.sqs-cart-quantity');
// Handler
function handler(target) {
if (target.innerHTML === '0') {
cart.setAttribute('hidden', '');
}
else {
cart.removeAttribute('hidden');
}
}
// Observer handler
var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
handler(mutations[0].target);
});
// Hide/show the cart when the page is loaded
handler(cartQty);

// Hide/show the cart when an item was added/removed
observer.observe(cartQty, {childList: true });
}
})();
</script>
